tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Find restaurants, cafes, dhabas, bakeries, bars and sweet shops by words and place. Returns id, name, kind, cuisines, locality, city, url and whether a phone number is on file.

tools.name: get_restaurant
tools.description: Full record by id (IRR-XXXXXXXXXX or the 10-char code at the end of its url): address, geo, phones, website, timings (raw + parsed, open_now in IST), cuisines, diet, ratings, menu summary, sources and confidence.

tools.name: search_dishes
tools.description: Find specific dishes on restaurant menus across India: item name, price in INR, veg/non-veg, menu section, and the restaurant (name, area, url). E.g. q "paneer tikka" city "bengaluru" max_price 300 veg true, or "masala dosa in indiranagar". Covers restaurants whose menus we hold (growing daily); if

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Menu sections and items with prices in INR and veg/non-veg marks, with the menu source and date. Null when no menu is on file.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Browse the place hierarchy with restaurant counts. type=state (all), type=city with parent=state:<slug>, type=locality with parent=city:<slug>.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: A city (city:<slug>) or area (loc:<city>:<area>) with counts by kind and cuisine and its areas.

tools.name: report_correction
tools.description: Tell IndiaRestros that something is wrong: a dead phone number, new timings, a closure, a move. Checked before it goes live. Ask the user before sending.

tools.name: about_dataset
tools.description: Counts, sources, top cities, how ranking works and how to read confidence.
